'''Swamp troopers''' were a division of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] tasked with operating in [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] environments. Swamp troopers were deployed to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Marca/Legends|Marca]] to provide security for the [[DSI Hyperbaride Synthesis Plant]]. They were supported by [[Mekuun Corporation/Legends|Mekuun Corporation]] [[repulsor scout]]s.

==Equipment==
The swamp troopers wore a [[Swamp trooper armor|specialized armor]], and were equipped with various sensors to allow for operation in swamplands.

They also carried a specialized blaster that doubled as both a blaster and a grappling device.
